description: Address generator that walks a four-step permutation inside an address space of 2 to 32 steps

params.text: Shifts the whole permutation through the address space, 0 to 31 steps
Picks which of the 24 permutations of four steps is walked
X puts out the step number as it stands; Y swaps the row and column of the step number, which walks down a 4x4 grid in place of across it
Sets how many steps the address space holds, 2 to 32; use 16 to address TD4

inputs.text: Each rising edge moves on to the next step of the permutation
A rising edge returns to the first step of the permutation and blocks the clock for 1ms
Sets the offset, 1.6 steps per volt over 0-10V, and overrides the Ofs knob while patched
Selects the permutation, 2.4 permutations per volt over 0-10V, and overrides the Perm knob while patched
Picks X below 5V and Y at 5V and above, and overrides the switch while patched

outputs.text: The current step as a voltage, with the whole address space spread over 0-10V

menu: Reset on Offset Change — restarts the permutation whenever the Ofs input moves the offset

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.1: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
